sourceEvidence.title: Senior Manager - Intelligent Process Automation and Reengineering
sourceEvidence.quote:
## Skills Required
* Typically 5–10 years of relevant experience
* Post-secondary degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, information technology, business, administration, or a related field
* In-depth knowledge of robotics, intelligent process automation, machine learning, and data-driven solutions
* Experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders and subject matter experts to implement projects
* Experience participating in cross-functional programs from conceptualization through delivery and ongoing operations
* Experience in process mapping and transformation
* Experience in project planning and execution, including scoping, budgeting, and risk and issue management
* Experience with WorkFusion, UiPath, and other automation tools
* Expert verbal and written communication skills
* Expert analytical and problem-solving skills
* Expert influencing skills
* Expert collaboration and cross-group teamwork skills
* Ability to manage ambiguity
* Expert data-driven decision-making skills
* Master’s degree concentrated in machine learning or data science
* Experience managing a software development life cycle
* Experience leading product roadmaps
